persons.name: Design Engineer

systems.name: bodesign MCP Server
systems.description: AI PCB design copilot delivered as a standalone MCP server

systems.name: KiCad Toolchain
systems.description: kicad-cli + pcbnew: ERC/DRC, gerber export, native tool results

containers.name: workflow-core
containers.description: Requirement planning, orchestration spine, reference crosscheck, workflow contracts

containers.name: design-ir
containers.description: BoardDesign IR schema + deterministic reference comparator (G7)

components.name: Requirement Planner
components.description: A1: extracts requirements and binds RequirementContract (metric/threshold/oracle); escalates unverifiable items

components.name: Design Review Gate
components.description: A2: pre-implementation scenario walkthrough producing DesignReviewRecord verdicts

components.name: Reference Crosschecker
components.description: A3: CrossCheckDiff with per-dimension severity and first_divergence; cost-ordered debug ladder

components.name: Evidence Adapter
components.description: A4: wraps native tool results into ValidationEvidence envelopes, raw_result preserved

components.name: Orchestration Spine
components.description: A5: persists evidence_returns/ records, updates requirement verification_status, fail-fast on malformed payloads

components.name: Workflow Plan Deriver
components.description: A6: computes ReferenceBoardWorkflowPlan stage status from spine state; static plan demoted to template

components.name: Reference Comparator
components.description: G7/DD-10~13: deterministic IR-vs-IR matching (two-stage + Hungarian) and weighted scoring (Dice/attr/conn 0.4/0.2/0.4); emits CrossCheckDiffItem details, wrappable as ValidationEvidence

relationships.description: Component/pin-level match details + sub-scores feed crosscheck diff
